category_tips.biology: 用类比（细胞=工厂，DNA=蓝图）；生命周期用循环图；物种用真实照片或写实插画
category_tips.medicine: 身体部位用简化示意；常见病用症状清单；急救用步骤图标
category_tips.chemistry: 元素用周期表色块；分子用积木比喻；反应前后对比
category_tips.physics: 定律用日常现象（重力=苹果落地）；矢量用箭头；能量用流动条
category_tips.engineering: 原理用爆炸图；历史用时间线；应用用真实案例

examples: Classroom poster on the water cycle for K-12, vertical 2:3. Title at top: 'The Water Cycle 水循环'. Center illustration: cartoon Earth with sun, ocean, clouds, mountains. 4 stages with icons: Evaporation (sun heating ocean), Condensation (cloud forming), Precipitation (rain falling), Collection (water gathering). Friendly cartoon characters observing. Fun fact box: 'Did you know? A water molecule has been cycling for billions of years!' Vibrant palette blue #3b82f6, yellow #eab308, green #10b981. 4K, K-12 classroom style.

University poster on quantum mechanics, vertical 2:3. Title: 'Quantum Mechanics 量子力学'. Key concepts: Wave-particle duality, Heisenberg uncertainty, Quantum entanglement. Visual explanations: double-slit experiment diagram, wave function plot, EPR paradox schematic. Equations in LaTeX style. Bilingual labels. University textbook illustration style. 4K.

High school poster on climate change, vertical 2:3. Title: 'Climate Change 气候变化'. Visual sections: greenhouse effect diagram, CO2 emissions trend, impacts (sea level, temperature), solutions (renewable energy). Cartoon illustrations with semi-realistic elements. Vibrant but factual palette. 4K.
accuracy_tips: 科普内容无基本科学错误；术语与目标学段匹配；类比恰当不误导；中英对照术语准确；引用真实数据时标来源；视觉吸引力强但不过度娱乐化；适合目标学段认知水平。
